en: The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of what appears to be a trade fair or industrial exhibition booth. There are displays of large leather industrial goods on the left, and glassware and ceramics on the right, some in glass cabinets or placed on the floor. Several signs with Cyrillic text are visible above and within the booth, advertising factories and their products. The overall setting is indoors and seems to focus on manufacturing or industrial products.
